description: This Kotlin source file defines the UI for the post-onboarding tabs in an Android application. It utilizes Jetpack Compose to create a tabbed interface with icons and associated screens for Connect, Chat, Voice, Screen sharing, and Settings. The file manages state for the active tab, connection status, and navigation events, and includes composable functions for the top status bar and bottom navigation bar.

classes.name: HomeTab
classes.description: Enumeration representing the different tabs in the UI, each with a label and icon.

classes.name: StatusVisual
classes.description: Enumeration indicating the visual status indicator: Connected, Connecting, Warning, Error, Offline.

methods.name: PostOnboardingTabs
methods.description: Main composable function that manages the tabbed navigation UI, including status bar and bottom tabs, handling navigation and connection status.

methods.name: ScreenTabScreen
methods.description: Displays the screen sharing tab's content and handles refresh logic when connected.

methods.name: TopStatusBar
methods.description: Displays a top bar with connection status text and visual indicator.

methods.name: BottomTabBar
methods.description: Displays the bottom tab navigation with icons and labels for each tab.
